entries.content_plain: 6. greater than ... Sodom-- ( Mt 11:23 ). No prophets had been sent to Sodom, as there had been to Judea; therefore the punishment of the latter was heavier than that of the former. overthrown ... in a moment-- whereas the Jews had to endure the protracted and manifold hardships of a siege. no hands stayed on her-- No hostile force, as the Chaldeans in the case of Jerusalem, continually pressed on her before her overthrow. Jeremiah thus shows the greater severity of Jerusalem's punishment than that of Sodom. Zain.

entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10905"/><div sID="gen19616" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10905"/><hi type="bold">7. Nazarites--</hi>literally, "separated ones" (<reference osisRef="Num.6.2">Nu 6:2</reference>). They were held once in the highest estimation, but now they are degraded. God's blessing formerly caused their body not to be the less fair and ruddy for their abstinence from strong drink. Compare the similar case of Daniel, &c. (<reference osisRef="Dan.1.8-Dan.1.15">Da 1:8-15</reference>). Also David (<reference osisRef="1Sam.16.12">1Sa 16:12</reference>; <reference osisRef="1Sam.17.42">17:42</reference>). Type of Messiah (<reference osisRef="Song.5.10">So 5:10</reference>).<div eID="gen19616" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen19617" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">rubies--</hi>Gesenius translates, "corals," from a Hebrew root, "to divide into branches," from the branching form of corals.<div eID="gen19617" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen19618" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">polishing--</hi>They were like exquisitely cut and polished sapphires. The "sapphires" may represent the blue veins of a healthy person.<div eID="gen19618" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen19619" type="x-p"/> Cheth. <div eID="gen19619" type="x-p"/>
entries.content_plain: 7. Nazarites-- literally, "separated ones" ( Nu 6:2 ). They were held once in the highest estimation, but now they are degraded. God's blessing formerly caused their body not to be the less fair and ruddy for their abstinence from strong drink. Compare the similar case of Daniel, &c. ( Da 1:8-15 ). Also David ( 1Sa 16:12 ; 17:42 ). Type of Messiah ( So 5:10 ). rubies-- Gesenius translates, "corals," from a Hebrew root, "to divide into branches," from the branching form of corals. polishing-- They were like exquisitely cut and polished sapphires. The "sapphires" may represent the blue veins of a healthy person. Cheth.

Pe.

entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10914"/><div sID="gen19646" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10914"/>16. Ain and Pe are here transposed (<reference osisRef="Lam.4.16">La 4:16</reference>, <reference osisRef="Lam.4.17">17</reference>), as in <reference osisRef="Lam.2.16">La 2:16</reference>, <reference osisRef="2Cor.2.17">17</reference>; 3:46-51.<div eID="gen19646" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen19647" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">anger--</hi>literally, "face"; it is the countenance which, by its expression, manifests anger (<reference osisRef="Ps.34.16">Psa 34:16</reference>). Gesenius translates, "the person of Jehovah"; Jehovah present; Jehovah Himself (<reference osisRef="Exod.33.14">Ex 33:14</reference>; <reference osisRef="2Sam.17.11">2Sa 17:11</reference>).<div eID="gen19647" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen19648" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">divided--</hi>dispersed the Jews.<div eID="gen19648" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen19649" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">they respected not ... priests--</hi>This is the language of the Gentiles. "The Jews have no hope of a return: for they respected not even good priests" (<reference osisRef="2Chr.24.19-2Chr.24.22">2Ch 24:19-22</reference>) [Grotius]. Maurer explains it, "They (the victorious foe) regard not the (Jewish) priests when imploring their pity" (<reference osisRef="Lam.5.12">La 5:12</reference>). entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10919"/><div sID="gen19664" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10919"/><hi type="bold">21.
